name: EMA trend with ADX filter
description: Rides established trends: price above EMA with ADX confirming strength; exits when price loses the EMA.
entry_long: close crosses above ema_value and adx_value > 22
entry_short: close crosses below ema_value and adx_value > 22

name: Volatility squeeze breakout
description: After a Bollinger squeeze, trades the break of the upper or lower band.
entry_long: bbw_value_prev < bbw_value_prev20 * 0.8 and close crosses above bbands_UpperBand
entry_short: bbw_value_prev < bbw_value_prev20 * 0.8 and close crosses below bbands_LowerBand
